mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.username, a.role, c.name AS cinemaName, a.status, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_admin a LEFT JOIN t_cinema c ON c.id = a.cinema_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND (#{role} IS NULL OR a.role = #{role}) AND (#{cinemaId} IS NULL OR a.cinema_id = #{cinemaId}) ORDER BY a.id ASC
